title: Transportation secretary blames ‘routine’ equipment upgrade for grounding flights nationwide
summary: FAA administrator Bryan Bedford also said there's "zero evidence of anything AI-related."
llm_summary: The Transportation Secretary said that a nationwide grounding of flights was caused by a routine software‑upgrade to the FAA’s air‑traffic‑control system, not by any malfunction or cyber‑attack.
